# Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library — Archipelago

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) randomizer for **Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!**

The mod locks the game's 400 book series and 31 sections behind items. Shelving books sends checks. Items from the multiworld unlock more books and bookcases.

## What you need

- [Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4197610/Librarian_Tidy_Up_the_Arcane_Library/) on Steam (game 1.0.12 or 1.0.13).
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.4 or newer.
- UE4SS (experimental build). It is bundled in the release zip, so you do not download it.

## Install

The game folder is `Librarian Tidy Up the Arcane Library!` in your Steam `steamapps/common` folder.

1. Open the [latest release](../../releases/latest) and download both files: `Librarian-AP_v<version>.zip` and `librarian.apworld`.
2. Extract the zip anywhere. It holds a `Librarian/` folder.
3. Drag `Librarian/` onto the game folder. Say yes to merge.
4. Copy `librarian.apworld` into `custom_worlds/` in your Archipelago folder.
5. Steam Deck or Linux only: add a launch option. See [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#steam-deck-and-linux-proton).

Upgrading: do the same steps. The zip carries a blank `ap_config.json`, so merging replaces your saved server and slot. Back up `Mods/Librarian-AP/Scripts/ap_config.json` first if you want them back, or type them in again. Replace `librarian.apworld` too. Seeds made with 3.0.2 keep working with 3.0.3; regenerate any seed you have not started yet.

Where the files land:

- `Librarian/Binaries/Win64/Mods/Librarian-AP/` (the mod and `Scripts/ap_config.json`)
- `Librarian/Content/Paks/LogicMods/LibrarianAPHUDFix.pak`

## Play

1. Restart Archipelago. Click **Generate Template Options** and open `Librarian Tidy Up the Arcane Library.yaml`.
2. Set `name: Player1` and any options you want. Put the file in `Players/`.
3. Click **Generate**. Host the `.archipelago` file, or upload it.
4. Start the game. The Archipelago Connection menu opens at the title screen. Press **F4** to show or hide it.
5. Enter the server (for example `localhost:38281`), your slot name (`Player1`) and the password, if any. Click **Connect**.
6. The mod starts or loads the run for you. Wait 10 to 20 seconds while the shelves are set up.
7. Shelve books. Checks go out, items come in. When you reach your goal, the way out opens. Walk to the door.

Handy keys: **F8** shows what is left, **F9** reconnects with your saved details.

## Logs

The mod writes one log per launch to `Librarian/Binaries/Win64/Mods/Librarian-AP/logs/`. With a bug report, send the newest log file and your YAML.

## Known issues

- A BookSanity check can lag a moment behind the book that earned it. Pick the book up and place it again.
- A hidden book can turn invisible when you pick it up. Reload, or throw it out of bounds.

More in [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

## More

- [Options](docs/OPTIONS.md): every YAML option
- [Logic and rules](docs/LOGIC.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
- [Handing a run to another player](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#handing-a-run-to-another-player): `Librarian-AP_SaveShare.bat` on the release page
- [Developing](docs/DEVELOPING.md): build from source
- Credits: AP integration by Str8UpWHITE64. The game belongs to its developer and publisher.
- Licence: MIT, see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE). The bundled UE4SS is also MIT licensed, see [`third_party/UE4SS/README.md`](third_party/UE4SS/README.md).

# Librarian-AP 3.0.3

A fix release. Locked books stay hidden more reliably, several connection and save edge cases no longer lose checks, the end door behaves in every case, and the run log is much easier to read.

**Seeds:** seeds made with 3.0.2 keep working with 3.0.3, so there is no need to restart a run in progress. The apworld fixes below only apply to new seeds, so regenerate any seed you have not started yet.

## Install / upgrade

Download `Librarian-AP_v3.0.3.zip` and `librarian.apworld`. Merge the zip's `Librarian/` folder over the game folder, and replace `librarian.apworld` in `custom_worlds/`.

The zip carries a blank `ap_config.json`, so merging replaces your saved server and slot. Back up `Librarian/Binaries/Win64/Mods/Librarian-AP/Scripts/ap_config.json` first if you want them back, or just type them in again.

## New

- **Hand a run to another player.** If you can't finish a run, `Librarian-AP_SaveShare.bat` exports your save to a zip on your Desktop, and the new player imports it with the same tool. It goes into a free AP save slot and never overwrites one of their saves, and it never holds your password. They connect as your slot and the mod loads the save by itself. Close the game first. Full steps: [Handing a run to another player](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#handing-a-run-to-another-player).  Windows only for now.


- **Shelf trap notices name the spot.** Scramble Shelf and Shelf Spill now say which bookcase and row they hit, for example "Scramble Shelf: 2 books on bookcase 2J, row 1 are out of order". A shelf trap that cannot run (you are carrying books, or nothing is shelved) says it was skipped.
- **A readable run log.** The mod writes one log per launch to `Mods/Librarian-AP/logs/` (`AP_<date>_<time>.log`, the newest ten are kept). Items and checks are written by name, and a short status snapshot is written after connecting and every five minutes. For a hard-to-pin-down bug, add `"debug": true` to `ap_config.json` to keep the detailed lines too. The log is also much quieter than before.
- **Shorter README.** Full option, logic and troubleshooting docs now live in the `docs/` folder. The mod is MIT licensed.

## Fixes (in the game)

- **Locked books stay hidden.** Locked books are now hidden through the game's own book piles, which fixes locked books that could still be seen on their shelves.
- A book whose item has arrived but whose bookcase is still shut stays hidden until the bookcase opens. Before, it could show up when you walked up to it.
- Your starting series are revealed straight away. Before, they could stay hidden until your first item arrived.
- Books that a stack put-down left buried in the floor or stuck inside a wall or bookcase are laid back on open floor, where you can pick them up.
- Floor Shuffle right after a Shelf Spill no longer snaps the spilled books back. Scramble Shelf never leaves a book outside every slot.
- A check sent just as the connection dropped is sent again after you reconnect. Before, its item was lost until you restarted the game.
- Section, floor, level and chest checks made while your save was still being verified are now sent once it is verified (or accepted with F7). Before, they could be lost for the session.
- Auto New Game no longer starts over a run whose save is missing (for example on a new PC). Restore the save and reconnect to get the run back.
- Closing the Archipelago window at the title and then connecting anyway no longer switches off auto New Game and the start-up pause.
- After Back to Title, Continue holds you in the pause menu until the locked books are hidden again, the same as a fresh start.
- The end door works normally again when you play without Archipelago (mod installed, not connected).
- Insight and Assemble no longer stop recharging after you try the end door before your goal.

## Fixes (generation, for new seeds)

- `local_filler` in multiworlds: your filler no longer piles up at the end of your seed, and multiplayer seeds with count checks generate much faster.
- `random_book_bundle` with `bookcase_unlocks: unlocked`: bundles now draw from the whole library instead of the two starting sections.
- Small custom goals (25 to 45 rows) with series or book bundles now generate. Before, some seeds were refused or left items unplaced.
- Faster generation with the big item pools (individual books and book bundles). Same placements as before.

No YAML options were added or changed.
